title: Continuity of the closed Gaussian profile
statement: Let $a,b\in\mathbb R$ with $a\in[0,1]$ and $a+b\in[0,1]$. As $\rho$ tends to $1$ from below, the closed Gaussian profile at $a+\rho b$ tends to its value at $a+b$.
replaced: Let $\Phi,\varphi$ be the standard Gaussian distribution function and density, and let $\overline I(p)=\varphi(\Phi^{-1}(p))$ for $0<p<1$, with $\overline I(p)=0$ elsewhere. If $a,a+b\in[0,1]$, then $\lim_{\rho\to1^-}\overline I(a+\rho b)=\overline I(a+b)$.
